content: In recent years, while several tools for core natural language understanding tasks involving syntactic and semantic analysis have been developed for noisy social media text BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 , BIBREF3 , there is little work on question answering or reading comprehension over social media, with the primary bottleneck being the lack of available datasets. We observe that recently proposed QA datasets usually focus on formal domains, e.g. CNN/DailyMail BIBREF4 and NewsQA BIBREF5 on news articles; SQuAD BIBREF6 and WikiMovies BIBREF7 that use Wikipedia.
